The Tahasildar, Shiggaon submitted a proposal for acquisition of land in R.S. No.236/1 measuring 35 guntas belonging to the petitioner for construction of access road to Tahasildar Office and also to the Civil Court.

Thereafter, preliminary notification was issued under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as "Act of 2013") for acquisition of the land.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Petitioner's grievance is that though the land is proposed for acquisition by issuing the preliminary notification, however, the respondents have not passed an award determining the compensation to which the petitioner is legally entitled.

2. The Deputy Commissioner, Haveri has filed an affidavit dated 15.12.2022 stating that the rehabilitation and resettlement was conducted as stated under Section 16(1) of the Act of 2013, and after the publication of Rehabilitation and Resettlement reports, final notification will be issued within a period of 12 months from the date of preliminary notification, and the same will be published in official gazette.

NC: 2024:KHC-D:705 2. Learned HCGP on instructions submits that the draft of the final notification is sent to the government for approval on 19.12.2023, and the acquisition proceedings will be concluded by passing an award within three months from today.
3. Submission is placed on record.

4. Therefore, it is expedient to dispose off the petition directing the respondents to conclude the acquisition proceedings in respect of the land R.S. No.236/1 measuring 35 guntas situated at Shiggaon town by passing an award under Section 25 of the Act of 2013 within three months from today.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The Tahasildar, Shiggaon submitted a proposal for acquisition of land in R.S. No.236/1 measuring 35 guntas belonging to the petitioner for construction of access road to Tahasildar Office and also to the Civil Court.
Thereafter, preliminary notification was issued under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as "Act of 2013") for acquisition of the land.
Petitioner's grievance is that though the land is proposed for acquisition by issuing the preliminary notification, however, the respondents have not passed an award determining the compensation to which the petitioner is legally entitled.
opennyai_summary.decision:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:705 2. Learned HCGP on instructions submits that the draft of the final notification is sent to the government for approval on 19.12.2023, and the acquisition proceedings will be concluded by passing an award within three months from today.
4. Therefore, it is expedient to dispose off the petition directing the respondents to conclude the acquisition proceedings in respect of the land R.S. No.236/1 measuring 35 guntas situated at Shiggaon town by passing an award under Section 25 of the Act of 2013 within three months from today.
Liberty is reserved with the petitioner to revive this petition, in the event, respondent fails to pass an award as directed by this Court.
